_comment: D5 model set (matrix section 3). q27 is the bf16 qwen3.8-27b checkpoint and q27f the NVFP4 anchor (qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4, M16 run 2026-09-22). request_bytes are the M16 steady measurements (run matrix-20260923T034935Z): q4 24 GiB, q14 46 GiB, q27 78 GiB, q27f 40 GiB, q30 82 GiB.
P2: the first live run of each model measures its peak; record it in measured.json (gen_budgets.py suggest) and regenerate fixtures and budgets. Reservations always use the declared request.
kv_cache_bytes is declared so resolution never has to derive it; weights_bytes_estimate is only for the fit check in gen_budgets.py (weights + kv + 8 GiB margin <= request).
quantization and kv_cache_dtype are per engine family: null means the field is omitted and the engine detects it from the checkpoint. Whether an engine serves the anchor is unproven (G17).

M16 2026-09-23: SGLang's static pool is the request minus the 8 GiB placeholder margin (ADR 0014 section 5), so a request below weights + KV + 8 GiB leaves no KV cache and the engine refuses (live, s17-4 at 16 GiB: mem_fraction_static 0.068). q4 is 20 GiB and q14 42 GiB so the margin fits; M16 then measures the real peak.

M16 2026-09-23 engine findings: SGLang 0.5.20 refuses --language-model-only for Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration, so language_model_only is per engine and off for SGLang on q27/q27f; vLLM 0.29 on q30 ran the host out of memory in FlashInfer MoE JIT and passed with --moe-backend triton through extra arguments. The NVFP4 startup peak (about 130 GiB MemAvailable drop) is transient JIT, not the request.

2026-09-23 co-residence variant (gen_deployment.py --co): context 8192 and a smaller KV cache, sized so q30+q4 and q27f+q14+q4 fit the normal 80% budget (97.35 GiB) together. Each request is weights + KV + the 8 GiB margin with the remainder spread as headroom; they are planning values, not measurements. No startup peak is declared: the store's placeholder (request, or weights x 1.6 + 8 GiB with known weights) applies until a first run measures it. Set co.startup_bytes to declare one.
